steps.sub: trade a little bias for far less variance

code:
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline

ridge_model = make_pipeline(
    StandardScaler(),
    Ridge(alpha=1.0)
)
ridge_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
caption: Ridge shrinks all coefficients toward zero -- a good default when most features carry a little real signal.

code:
from sklearn.linear_model import Lasso

lasso_model = make_pipeline(
    StandardScaler(),
    Lasso(alpha=0.01, max_iter=10000)
)
lasso_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
coefs = lasso_model.named_steps["lasso"].coef_
print(f"Features kept: {(coefs != 0).sum()}")
caption: Lasso can zero out coefficients entirely, but picks arbitrarily among strongly correlated features.
